check_external_auth: check if a user is a member of an organization using an external authentication URL
validate_fine_grained_permissions: validate that a fine-grained access token has the required permissions for an organization
validate_role_based_permissions: validate that a token has the required role and organization permissions
handle_auth_response_codes: handle HTTP 200, 401, 403, and 404 response codes from an external authentication service
review_auth_check: review the auth_check function to understand how it validates user membership and token permissions
